checks: Distinct cached replies in `.cache/llm`: 1075 (621 Sonnet, 454 Opus). Live calls: 1080. The 5 extra are Sonnet prompts asked live twice: the warm-up and the scored run's Sonnet lane ran in separate processes and both missed the cache on the same prompt (187 + 288 = 475 live Sonnet calls after 07:20:39, 470 distinct replies).

The scored TEST run's ledger does not split calls by model (added after the run); its Opus count is the number of Opus replies cached during the run, whose input tokens sum to exactly the ledger's 288,151 Opus input tokens. Phases with no ledger kept are counted from cache-file times and so cannot show duplicates.

Pacing: within one process each model waited for its own limiter at the account quota (Sonnet 10/min, Opus 5/min; --rpm 40 was capped at the quota). Two processes ran Sonnet at once during TEST (the warm-up and the scored lane, each at 10/min): about 15 Sonnet calls a minute were cached from 07:20 to 08:10, above the 10/min quota, which is where most of the 324 throttling retries in the warm-up log and the 9 throttled-out rows came from. `full_eval warm --quota-share` now splits the quota between processes.
